name: Training the Beast
label: Quest
description: Training the Beast is the culminating rite of passage for fledgling night elf hunters in Teldrassil. After proving their mastery by taming wild beasts…
intro: Training the Beast is the culminating rite of passage for fledgling night elf hunters in Teldrassil. After proving their mastery by taming wild beasts across the boughs, hunters are sent to Darnassus to learn the deeper arts of pet care and discipline from Jocaste.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it.
Travel to Darnassus. There you must speak to one of our most revered hunters, Jocaste. She will give you the ability to train your new pet, so make haste.
While Jocaste may seem stern, she is always pleased to see another hunter rising through the ranks. Treat her with respect and she will return in kind. Good luck, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A fledgling hunter, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.
Remember, friend, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
